_comment: Ratchet ceiling per locale, from catalogue-audit.ts. A locale's issue count must never exceed its number here -- see catalogue-audit.test.ts. Lower a number (and commit) as a translation batch actually fixes issues; raise one only when Phase 3 adds new keys to en.ts, which every untranslated locale is then 'missing' until its own batch lands. Never raise a number to make a red test pass. Batch raised 2026-09-23: MegaMenuNav's ~75 mega-menu labels and About/Gallery/bulk-order-preset/journal-essay strings (~132 keys total) were extracted from hardcoded English into new catalogue keys and merged with an English fallback in every locale so nothing broke -- they read as untranslated ('wrong-script') until a real translation batch lands for them. Every locale's other issues (Devanagari 'same-as-hi' padding cleanup) went down in the same pass; only the new-key count went up.
